hypothesis: H-TURN as a MECHANISM: rest the fee-safe complement while extending and let FILLS determine the turn. Not a classifier, not a prediction.

mutation_incapable.detail: no order-capable module is importable from this process

book_provenance.why: FORENSIC.md §4 asks for both tokens' top-of-book over the canonical sequence's own windows (2026-03-27..04-21, 2026-08-28..31). No such series is on disk.
book_provenance.anonymous_depth: every level is SIZE AT A PRICE and is never attributed to L5 or any trader

regime.note: the pooled figure IS the R4 figure. L5's ex-incentive baseline is NEGATIVE in R4 (-$5,851, -30.4bp), so no pooled number here is advertised as current expectancy.

side.note: the mechanism rests the complement of ITS OWN surplus, so the side is not free -- but it is not identical to L5's either, because the shadow does not take his completes and its surplus therefore drifts from his. A disagreement is a real behavioural divergence

fill_timing.reading: delta < 0 means the mechanism's resting complement was hit BEFORE L5's own turn fill. A turn the mechanism never gets hit on is a MISS and is counted as one

price.reading: shadow complement limit price minus L5's own complete price, both in the complement outcome's own terms

pair_cost.note: the ceiling check is a CONSTRUCTION invariant: the mechanism cannot quote above it. L5's own running pair cost is a MEASUREMENT of him. Neither is realized P&L for our account

inventory_trajectory.note: SHADOW residual. Not submitted, filled, settled, realized

partial_fills.note: inventory is booked on every one of these, partial included; a partial leaves the remainder resting

mirror_dependency.why: 26.4% of L5's BTC15m maker fills price at or above the prevailing ask -- a complete-set mint a resting bid cannot do (ZENODO_OVERLAP_FINDINGS.md §2)
